breaks.quote: If the answer is no, prune. Pick something that still matters to you and prune it.
breaks.why: The ask to end things that still matter rests on the author's one story, so a doubtful reader can shrug and keep their list.

breaks.quote: Pruning hurts, and it will hurt you too.
breaks.why: Naming the pain is not an answer to the reader's strongest doubt, that every item on their list matters.

breaks.quote: And this time, there will be room in your month to give it 100%.
breaks.why: The payoff for the reader is given in one sentence, so the benefit is named and not argued in the reader's own life.
